content: Dhruv Kapoor followed up with insurance agent Vikram Patel regarding the renewal of his health policy and the signed form he submitted last week. Vikram confirmed receipt of the form and explained that it is currently under review by the underwriting team, with a response expected by tomorrow. Vikram also clarified that the policy currently shows as expired but will be reinstated as soon as the underwriting team approves the renewal.

action_items: Underwriting team to review the signed form and provide an update by tomorrow
Vikram Patel to keep Dhruv Kapoor posted on renewal progress
